answer: Plume-sealed voyage parcels stop bulk fakes. A newcomer stakes 70 credits and seals one parcel with a unique plume mark on the open voyage board. Carrying it earns a signed signal stamp per checkpoint; auditors match plume mark and signal stamps, and a broken seal or gap forfeits the stake. Hired couriers stake their own bonds. First fake 40, kth 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000, chase 40,000 rewards. Honest agents pay 40 once.
